# Step - in_v

`in_v` · `inV` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves from an edge to its in (head) vertex.

## Forms

```text
in_v()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e("0").in_v().values("name").next()   // vadas
```
